purpose: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Replace the 0x55 idle heartbeat with a 35-byte status packet carrying the eight camera_a1_uart_top counters, rebuild the r0 candidate, download once over SRAM, capture COM8 for 60 s and locate which stage (raw publish / A+ read+commit / compressed publish+export) is stuck. Not a production candidate.

rtl_changes.summary: a1_uart_export: new STS_DIV parameter (default 0), eight sts_* counter inputs, 35-byte packet FSM latched snapshot, XOR over bytes 0..33, frame-start arbitration (packet only in E_IDLE with empty queue; E_IDLE cannot open a frame while the packet is on the wire). camera_a1_uart_top: STS_DIV=187500000 default (1.000 s at 187.5 MHz), wires the eight counters (identical expressions to o_st_*) into the exporter, st_errors_all factors o_st_errors.
rtl_changes.not_changed: A+ core (r0 copy 29b1e3e1...), a1_frame_top.v, a1_ddr_slot_store.v, a1_ddr_arb2.v, a1_raw_crop.v, capture_async_fifo.v, p2_a1_board_top.v, p2_ddr_bridge.v, p2_a1_pll.v, p2_board.sdc, board_p2.adc, frame header/CRC/byte order/DDR layout, UART_DIV=1628. No false path, no multicycle, no seed change, no clock change.

status_packet_contract.counter_sources: crop_frames, raw_st_pub, cmp_st_pub, exp_exported, raw_st_drop, cmp_st_drop, (raw_st_err+cmp_st_err+exp_err), raw_st_read -- the same expressions as o_st_cap_frames/o_st_raw_pub/o_st_enc_frames/o_st_exported/o_st_raw_drop/o_st_cmp_drop/o_st_errors/o_st_read_words
status_packet_contract.heartbeat: legacy 0x55 beacon is disabled when STS_DIV > 0 (hb_en = HB_DIV>0 && STS_DIV==0); the frozen top's HB_DIV=4194304 is therefore inert in this build

build.flow: r1-diag/td/01_build.tcl, 02_bitgen.tcl, 03_cwc.tcl (copied from r0 unchanged except the two add_files redirects)

route.worst_path: clk_a1->clk_a1 0.173 ns, endpoint u_a1/u_raw_store/st_dup_words_reg[16]_syn_2.cea (stat counter CE, unrelated to this round)
route.gate: 0 violations PASS; WNS +0.173 >= +0.05 PASS; below preferred +0.2 -> CAVEAT recorded

sim_check.result: 6 packets, 210 bytes, 0 stop-bit errors, 0 bad XOR; all eight constants reproduced in little-endian order

board.download_facts: R1D_DL_DEVICE=PH1P100; PRG-2014 Chip validation success; R1D_DL_OK mode=jtag(sram); 33.8 s; one benign 'Error @ mpsse.cpp:90 usb_open() failed' line from the hwserver channel probe before validation; no Flash
board.verdict: All eight counters are 0 for the whole 60 s. The status packet proves clk_a1, a1_rst_n (PLL+DDR ready), UART TX and the pin are alive. cap_frames=0 (complete-ROI counter in a1_raw_crop) puts the blocker in the camera front end (MIPI RX / f9p A tap / crop), upstream of the raw store, the A+ core and the exporter. This run does NOT prove or disprove A+ core behaviour on silicon: it was never reached.
